name: Microwave Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: ½ tsp each cumin and black pepper
steps: Microwave the oil, onion and garlic in a large bowl for 2 minutes.
Add the pumpkin, cumin and 2 tbsp stock; cover and microwave for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the beans and the remaining stock and microwave 3 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
note: White beans add creaminess and protein without any cream.
